blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Agent harnesses require a low-latency guardrail model together with customizable audit policies. However, deploying an auto-regressive guardrail model remains challenging: such models incur high inference latency and are often poorly aligned with customized policies. To address these problems, we present Jev-Guard, a unified model for safety classification and policy routing. We further construct a policy tree over which Jev-Guard performs routing, spanning diverse domains including content moderation, cybersecurity, privacy, and legal compliance. Specifically, Jev-Guard first navigates the policy tree to select the applicable audit policy given the caller's audit context, and then performs safety classification conditioned on the retrieved policies. On 7,033 evaluation cases, Jev-Guard achieves 93.72\% safety accuracy, a mean latency of 58ms, and 93.10\% hierarchical routing accuracy. The full routing-and-classification pipeline averages 240ms. Furthermore, we integrate Jev-Guard into the Hermes harness framework. Across agent trajectories, its separate permission gate cuts mean review time per task from 4.80s for an SFT-LLM judge to 1.33s, with no policy violations are observed for either guard.
blocks.zh: 代理设备需要低纬度的护栏模型以及可定制的审计政策。 然而,采用自动递归式护栏模式仍然具有挑战性:这种模式具有很高的推论延迟性,而且往往与定制政策不相一致。 为了解决这些问题,我们提出Jev-Guard,一个安全分类和政策路线的统一模式。 包括内容节制、网络安全、隐私和法律合规。 具体来说,Jev-Guard首先在政策树上导航,根据呼叫者的审计背景选择适用的审计政策,然后在收回的政策上进行安全分类。 在7,033个评价案件中,Jev-Guard实现了93.72\%的安全精度,平均潜伏度为58ms;93.10\%分等级的路由精度. 全线贯通-分级管线平均240m. 此外,我们还将Jev-Guard纳入Hermes的利用框架。 纵观代理轨迹,其单独的许可门切口意味着每任务的审查时间从SFT-LLM法官的4.80分到1.33分,而任何一名警卫都没有违反政策的情况。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Agent harnesses execute tool calls on behalf of users, and every action must be reviewed before it takes effect ( Wang et al., 2026a ; Mou et al., 2026 ) . Such review sits on the critical path of each step, so it demands a low-latency guardrail model. It also demands customizable audit policies: sending a public announcement to an approved partner differs from sending a private document to an address found in a webpage, and the two cases require different audit tasks. Across content moderation, cybersecurity, privacy, and legal compliance, the same agent action may call for vulnerability analysis, a disclosure check, or a review under a particular platform policy. An unsafe label alone identifies neither the audit task nor the execution authority.
blocks.zh: Agent japes代表用户执行工具呼叫,每项行动在生效前都必须经过审查(Wang等,2026a; Mou等, 2026 (英语). 这种审查是在每一步骤的关键道路上进行的,因此需要一种低纬度的护栏模型。 它还要求有定制的审计政策:向经核准的伙伴发送公告不同于向网页中找到的地址发送私人文件,这两种情况需要不同的审计任务。 在内容节制、网络安全、隐私和法律合规方面,同一代理机构的行动可能要求根据某一特定平台政策进行脆弱性分析、披露检查或审查。 仅是不安全的标签既不能确定审计任务,也不能确定执行当局。

blocks.en: Existing guardrail models fall short of these two requirements. First, policy-conditioned safeguards typically generate an auto-regressive rationale before emitting a verdict ( Li et al., 2025c ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , which incurs high inference latency at every tool invocation. Second, such models are often poorly aligned with customized policies. Fixed taxonomies restrict deployments to a shared vocabulary, whereas placing all natural-language policies into the context for every action enlarges the input and introduces irrelevant candidates. Hierarchical labels help organize categories ( Li et al., 2025a ) , but they do not let operators rename a category, remove it with a fallback, or insert a new routing level without retraining. Such edits change the decision interface even when the underlying action stays fixed, so a frozen model must follow the changed rules.
blocks.zh: 现有的护卫车型号没有达到这两项要求. 首先,有政策条件的保障措施通常在发布判决前产生自动倒退的理由(Li等,2025c;Liu等,2026;Chen等,2025),这在每一个工具引用时都会产生高度推论性。 第二,这种模式往往与定制政策不相适应。 固定分类限制对共同词汇的使用,而将所有自然语言政策纳入每个行动的背景,则会扩大投入,引进无关紧要的候选人。 分级标签帮助组织类别(Li等,2025a),但不会让操作者重新命名一个类别,去掉后退,或者插入一个新的行道级而不再培训. 这种编辑即使在基础动作保持固定时也会改变决定界面,所以被冻结的模型必须遵循被改变的规则.

blocks.en: To address these problems, we present Jev-Guard, a unified model for safety classification and policy routing. Following the direct structured-decision paradigm of Jev ( Typesafe AI, 2026 ) and the Open-Jev implementation family ( Open-Jev Contributors, 2026 ) , Jev-Guard is a Qwen3.5-2B classifier that replaces generated rationales with direct prediction heads. We further construct a versioned policy tree over which Jev-Guard performs routing, with 85 nodes and 73 leaves spanning content moderation, cybersecurity, privacy, and legal compliance. Given an agent action, Jev-Guard first navigates the tree through local decisions to select the applicable audit policy given the caller’s audit context, and then performs safety classification conditioned on the retrieved leaf rules and taxonomy. Operators can inspect and revise the tree without retraining, and only the policies relevant to the current action enter the context.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们提出Jev-Guard,一个安全分类和政策路线的统一模式。 遵循Jev(Typesafe AI,2026年)和Open-Jev执行家族(Open-Jev Controductioners,2026年)的直接结构化决定范式,Jev-Guard是一款以直接预测头取代所生成原理的Quen3.5-2B分级器. Jev-Guard的路线由85个节点和73个叶子组成, 鉴于代理人的行动,Jev-Guard首先通过当地决定选择适用的审计政策,根据呼叫人的审计背景,然后在取回的叶子规则和分类学上进行安全分类。 操作员可以在不进行再培训的情况下检查并修改树,只有与当前行动相关的政策才会进入背景.

blocks.en:
We evaluate Jev-Guard on 7,033 cases. It achieves 93.72% safety accuracy with a mean latency of 58 ms and 93.10% hierarchical routing accuracy. The full routing-and-classification pipeline averages 240 ms. Beyond classification, we integrate Jev-Guard into the Hermes harness ( Nous Research, 2026 ) , where an independent permission judgment and scope checks govern execution, and native leaf predictions serve as diagnostics. This separation matters for legitimate analysis of harmful material: recognizing phishing content should not automatically prohibit saving it for an authorized investigation. In agent trajectories built on executable simulated environments ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) , the separate permission gate reviews faster than an LLM judge but completes fewer normal tasks, and neither guard shows policy violations.
Our contributions are threefold: 1. A unified model and editable policy tree. We present Jev-Guard, a 2B direct classifier that performs hierarchical policy routing and policy-conditioned safety classification over an editable policy tree spanning content moderation, cybersecurity, privacy, and legal compliance. 2. A four-domain data construction pipeline. We map tasks from the four domains to policy leaves while preserving source-specific safety meanings and annotation masks. 3. Strong accuracy at low latency. On 7,033 evaluation cases, Jev-Guard achieves 93.72% safety accuracy and 93.10% hierarchical routing accuracy at 58 ms mean latency (240 ms for the full pipeline), and in Hermes the permission gate reviews faster than an LLM judge at a lower normal-task completion rate.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: GSPR trains safeguards to reason across supplied safety policies and taxonomies ( Li et al., 2025c ) . Augmented policy training studies generalization to unseen policy domains ( Liu et al., 2026 ) . Hi-Guard combines policy-aligned moderation with hierarchical labels ( Li et al., 2025a ) . These methods establish policy conditioning and hierarchical labels. We instead freeze the model and perturb rules, candidate wording, membership, and tree topology to test whether software edits produce the intended decisions.
blocks.zh: 普惠制审查培训保障措施是为了在所提供的安全政策和分类中说明理由(Li等,2025c)。 加强政策培训研究,普及到看不见的政策领域(Liu等,2026年)。 Hi-Guard将政策上的节制与分级标签结合起来(Li等,2025a.). 这些方法确立了政策规定和等级标签。 相反,我们冻结模型和扰动规则、候选措辞、会员资格和树木地貌,以检验软件编辑是否产生预期决定。

blocks.en: AgentSpec specifies runtime constraints with triggers, predicates, and enforcement mechanisms ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . ShieldAgent evaluates agent behavior using verifiable policy reasoning ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and ToolSafe studies proactive review at tool invocation steps ( Mou et al., 2026 ) . These systems enforce action policies. We study a direct classifier with a separate audit tree and permission gate, tracing which policy each decision reads. Our rollouts evaluate the integrated gate, whose policy is separate.
blocks.zh: AgentSpec具体规定了运行时间限制,带有触发,上游,执行机制(Wang等,2026a.). ShieldAgent利用可核查的政策推理来评价代理行为(Chen等,2025年),而TolleSafe则在工具引用步骤上进行主动审查(Mou等,2026年)。 这些系统执行行动政策。 我们研究一个直接的分类器,其中有一个单独的审计树和许可门,追踪每个决定所读的政策。 我们的推出评估了综合大门,其政策是分开的。

blocks.en: Jev motivates direct structured decisions rather than autoregressive explanations ( Typesafe AI, 2026 ) . We build on the Open-Jev implementation family ( Open-Jev Contributors, 2026 ) . We retain its head architecture and add four-domain task mapping and paired audit diagnostics. Official Jev is an external baseline. AgentDojo provides executable simulated environments for testing prompt injection attacks and defenses ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) . We use these tools in native Hermes rollouts ( Nous Research, 2026 ) , separating full attacker goals from partial policy violations.

blocks.en: The diagnosis r t r_{t} and the execution decision are separate outputs. Harmful material may legitimately be inspected, for example when phishing content is saved for an authorized investigation, so an unsafe diagnosis is a warning, not an automatic denial. blocks.en: 4 Data and Policy Tree Construction
blocks.zh: 4 数据和政策树建设

blocks.en: This section describes how we build the audit data and the policy tree used to train Jev-Guard.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍我们如何构建审计数据以及用来培训Jev-Guard的政策树.

blocks.en: 4.1 Data Collection and Construction
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 数据收集和建设

blocks.en: We gather public datasets for the four audit domains, and each dataset poses a different judgment task. Content tasks ask whether a prompt or response, in text or image form, is harmful and which harm category applies ( Ghosh et al., 2024 ; Zong et al., 2024 ; Zhu and others, 2025 ) . Cyber tasks include detecting vulnerable code ( Ding et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2023 ) , phishing and malicious web requests ( Dalton et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) , and prompt injection ( Yi et al., 2025 ) , classifying the root cause of a reported vulnerability ( Alam et al., 2024 ) , and judging whether a request is authorized ( Wang et al., 2026b ) . Privacy tasks annotate the practices in a privacy policy ( Wilson et al., 2016 ; Ahmad et al., 2021 ; Ravichander et al., 2019 ) and judge whether an information flow is appropriate ( Li et al., 2025b ) . Compliance tasks ask whether a text violates a given law or platform policy, such as GDPR or a provider’s terms of service. Most come from OmniCompliance-100K (Omni) ( Hu et al., 2026 ) , and the rest detect unfair clauses ( Lippi et al., 2019 ; Chalkidis et al., 2022 ) . The appendix lists every dataset.
blocks.zh: 我们为四个审计领域收集公共数据集,每个数据集都构成不同的判断任务. 内容任务询问文字或图像形式的即时反应或回应是否有害,适用哪类伤害(Ghosh等,2024;Zong等,2018年). 2024; 朱等, 2025 (中文(简体) ). 网络任务包括侦测脆弱码(Ding等,2025;Chen等,2023),钓鱼和恶意网络请求(Dalton等,2025;Liu等,2024),以及即时注射(Yi等,2025),对报告的脆弱性根源进行分类(Alam等,2024),并判断请求是否获得批准(Wang等,2026b.). 隐私任务对隐私政策中的做法进行注释(Wilson等,2016年;Ahmad等,2021年;Ravichander等,2019年)并判断信息流动是否恰当(Li等,2025年b). 合规任务询问文本是否违反特定的法律或平台政策,例如GDPR或提供者的服务条款. 大部分来自OmniConference-100K (Omni)(Hu等,2026年),其余发现不公平条款(Lippi等,2019年;Charkidis等,2022年). 附录列出了每个数据集。

blocks.en: Because the datasets use different formats, we convert every example into one record. It holds the evidence to review, the audit task, the applicable policy, the candidate labels with definitions, the labels, and the policy-tree leaf the example belongs to. The training set has 377,930 records. We remove instructions that ask for generated text, since the model outputs labels directly.
blocks.zh: 因为数据集使用不同的格式,所以我们把每个实例转换为一个记录. 它持有审查的证据、审计任务、适用的政策、带有定义的候选人标签、标签和实例所属的政策树叶。 该训练集拥有377,930个记录. 我们删除要求生成文本的指令,因为模型输出直接标记。

blocks.en: Labels differ in reliability, so we record where each comes from. Original labels are taken directly from the source dataset. Mapped labels are converted from source metadata by an explicit rule, for example an attack-family field mapped to an injection category. Weak labels are guessed by simple rules such as keyword matching, for example a privacy topic inferred from a sentence. Weak labels are used in training with a small loss weight of 0.25 and never in evaluation. A category that a source never annotated is treated as unknown rather than negative, so the model is not taught that an unlabeled category is absent.
blocks.zh: 标签的可靠性不同,所以我们记录每个标签的来源。 原始标签直接取自源数据集. Mapped标签通过一条明确的规则从源元数据转换而来,例如将攻击-家族字段映射为注入类. 弱标签被简单规则所猜测,比如关键词匹配,比如句子中推断出来的隐私话题. 弱标签被用在小减重为0.25的训练上,在评价中从未使用. 一个从未注解过源的分类被视作未知而非负数,因此模型没有被教导一个没有标签的分类不存在.

blocks.en: Table 1: Four-domain baseline comparison: safety accuracy (%). The first row gives matched cases per domain, and the other rows are the systems compared on the same 7,033 text records. Latency is the local per-case median without routing or permission checks. Prompts and training histories differ across systems.
blocks.zh: 表1:四领域基线比较:安全准确性(%)。 第一行给出每个域的匹配案例,而其他一行是同一7 033个文本记录上比较的系统. latency是本地的每例中位数,没有路由或许可检查. 各系统之间的提示和培训历史各不相同。

blocks.en: 4.2 Policy Tree Construction
blocks.zh: 4.2 政策树建设

blocks.en: We build the tree manually from source information, not from model predictions, and the model never sees dataset names.
blocks.zh: 我们从源信息,而不是从模型预测,手动构建出这棵树,而模型从未看到数据集名称.

blocks.en: We first assign each dataset an audit capability. Complete functions map to code review, vulnerability descriptions with Common Weakness Enumeration (CWE) labels ( MITRE, ) to root-cause classification, severity ratings to an ordinal task, and emails, URLs, and HTTP traffic to their own cyber leaves. Datasets with compatible tasks share a leaf. Compliance datasets keep the specific law or provider policy as their branch, grouped by provider and by law. The result has four top-level domains, 85 nodes, and 73 leaves.
blocks.zh: 我们首先为每个数据集分配审计能力。 完整函数映射到代码审查,带有常见弱点编号(CWE)标签的脆弱性描述(MITRE,)到根原因分类,对一个正统任务的重度评级,以及电子邮件,URL,以及HTTP流量到自己的网络叶. 兼容任务的数据集共享一叶. 合规数据集将具体的法律或提供者政策作为其分支,按提供者和法律分类。 结果有四个顶级域,85个节点,73个叶子.

blocks.en: Each leaf has its own list of candidate labels, rewritten into readable names. CWE codes are mapped to 20 defect families (e.g., CWE-119 and CWE-787 to Buffer bounds ), and broad codes that name no specific defect are masked. For policy clauses, we remove duplicated headings and numbers and keep distinct clause details as definitions. Each leaf also records the safety meaning of its native labels, since not every task has a safe or unsafe label.
blocks.zh: 每个叶子都有自己的候选标签列表,被重写为可读名. CWE代码被映射到20个缺陷家庭(如CWE-119和CWE-787到Buffer bounds),没有具体缺陷名称的宽码被遮掩. 就政策条款而言,我们删除了重复的标题和编号,保留不同的条款细节作为定义。 每片叶子还记录出其本土标签的安全意义,因为并不是每个任务都有安全或不安全的标签.

blocks.en: Routing walks the tree one step at a time, so each record’s leaf path gives one training example per branching node, in which the model chooses the next child. We sample 40/30/20/10% of examples at depths zero through three. The router set has 10,000 records, split 8,000/1,000/1,000 without shared evidence or source groups.
blocks.zh: 跑步逐一行走于树上,所以每个记录的叶道每个分支节点都会给出一个训练例子,其中模型选择下一个孩子. 我们抽取了40/30/20/10% 深度0到3的样本 路由器集拥有一万个记录,分出8000/1000/1000没有共享证据或源组.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en: We organize the experiments around four questions. RQ1 : Is Jev-Guard accurate and fast enough to review every action? RQ2 : Does a frozen model follow edits to rules, categories, and tree structure? RQ3 : What does the policy tree add over presenting all policies at once? RQ4 : How does the execution gate compare with an LLM judge?
blocks.zh: 我们围绕四个问题组织实验。 RQ1:Jev-Guard是否准确而快到足以审查每一项行动? RQ2 : (英语). 一个被冻结的模型是否遵循规则,分类和树结构的编辑? RQ3 : (中文(简体) ). 政策树在同时提出所有政策之后会增加什么? 问题4: 处决门与LLM法官相比如何?

blocks.en: The evaluated checkpoint continues an earlier version for one epoch and is selected at update 1,508. We train rank-8 LoRA and the prediction heads with learning rates × 10 − 5 2\!\times\!10^{-5} and × 10 − 5 5\!\times\!10^{-5} , respectively, a global batch of 256, and a 16,384-token cap. Selection averages routing, safety, and category scores on 2,048 native and 1,000 router validation records. Reported test safety uses ordinary accuracy.
blocks.zh: 经评价的检查站是一个时代的较早版本,在更新1 508中选定。 我们训练了八等的LORA和预言头 学习率×10 − 5 2\!\times\!10\5}和x10 − 5 5\!\times\!10\5}, 分别为全球256批, 和16 384个托克帽。 选取平均路由,安全,分类得分2,048个本土和1000个路由器验证记录. 报告测试安全使用普通的准确性.

blocks.en: We evaluate one frozen checkpoint as an empirical system study. Native scores describe recorded cohorts, not generalization to unseen policies, and edit experiments measure paired responses to newly specified variants.
blocks.zh: 我们评价一个被冻结的检查站作为经验系统研究。 原生分数描述被记录的组别,而不是被概括到隐形政策,并编辑实验量出对新指定的变体的配对反应.

blocks.en: 5.2 RQ1: Is Jev-Guard Accurate and Fast?
blocks.zh: 5.2 RQ1: Jev-Guard准确并快吗?

blocks.en: We compare Jev-Guard with a generative SFT model and official Jev on matched records, evaluate native classification across all four domains, and time the full review pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们把Jev-Guard与基因化的SFT模型和官方Jev在匹配的记录上进行比较,评价所有四个领域的本土分类,以及时间的全面审查。

blocks.en: On 7,033 matched records, Jev-Guard reaches 93.72% safety accuracy, against 93.36% for SFT and 75.89% for official Jev ( Typesafe AI, 2026 ) , and Table 1 gives the breakdown by domain. The 0.36-point gap over SFT has a 95% interval that includes zero, so we claim no accuracy advantage. The SFT median latency is 8.81 times that of Jev-Guard. Prompts and training histories differ across systems, so the comparison does not isolate architecture.
blocks.zh: 在7 033个匹配记录中,Jev-Guard的安全准确度达到93.72%,而SFT为93.36%,官方Jev为75.89%(Typesafe AI, 2026),表1给出了按域分列的细目. SFT的0.36分相差有95%的间隔,包括0,所以我们声称没有精度优势. SFT中位数是Jev-Guard的8.81倍. 提示和培训历史因系统而异,因此比较并不孤立建筑.

Safety accuracy is 91.78% over the 79,987 records with safety labels, and Table 2 shows how much it varies across domains and tasks. blocks.en: 5.3 RQ2: Does a Frozen Model Follow Policy Edits?
blocks.zh: 5.3 RQ2:一个被冻结的模型是否跟随政策编辑?

blocks.en: We keep the checkpoint frozen, edit rules, candidate lists, and tree structure, and score only newly specified variants. Table 4 summarizes all three edit types.
blocks.zh: 我们保留检查站的冻结,编辑规则,候选名单和树状结构,只得新指定的变体. 表4汇总了所有三种编辑类型。

blocks.en: We test five rule families: recipients, publication, storage region, retention, and security authorization. Each has six targets whose gold label changes under the edited rule and six unchanged controls, with gold set by predefined predicates. We score the compliant/violation choice and the binary safety output separately, without scope rules or execution. The choice head is correct on both versions of 21 of the 30 targets and on all 30 controls. The safety head is correct on all 30 targets but only 24 controls, because six legal 14-day retention actions stay unsafe. Tightening the retention limit from 90 to 30 days leaves the choice prediction at compliant for all six targets, although the safety head flips correctly. Head agreement and control correctness therefore need separate checks.

blocks.en: 5.4 RQ3: What Does the Policy Tree Add?
blocks.zh: 5.4 RQ3:政策树添加什么?

blocks.en: We compare hierarchical and flat leaf selection, and then four ways of presenting policies to the reviewer.
blocks.zh: 我们比较分级和平地的叶片选择,然后向审查者提出政策的四个方法.

blocks.en: We use 1,000 node-level test records from 977 unique source cases. Each record restarts at the root, both conditions receive the caller audit context and governing policy, and the final leaf is scored. The hierarchy chooses children recursively, while the flat condition selects among the same 73 leaf descriptions in one step. The hierarchy reaches 93.10% against 92.40% for flat selection. The 0.70-point gap has a 95% interval from − 0.10 -0.10 to 1.60 under a paired source-cluster bootstrap ( Efron and Tibshirani, 1994 ) , so we find no conclusive evidence that the hierarchy improves routing accuracy. Of the 69 hierarchy errors, 61 first diverge within cyber, where accuracy is 80.45%. Because 488 of the 1,000 records are named-policy compliance tasks, these scores measure caller-conditioned dispatch.
blocks.zh: 我们使用977个独特来源病例的1000个节点级测试记录. 每个记录从根起重新开始,条件都得到呼叫者的审计背景和治理政策,最后的叶子被打分. 分级顺序依次选择孩子,而平分条件则在同73个叶子描述中选择一步. 平面选择的等级达到93.10%,而92.40%。 0.70分的相差从-0.10-0.10到1.60之间的相差95%在一个对等的源集群靴子下(Efron和Tibshirani,1994年),因此我们没有找到确凿的证据证明等级提高了路线精度。 在69个等级错误中,61个首先在网络内部出现差异,准确度为80.45%. 由于1000个记录中有488个被命名为政策合规任务,这些分数衡量了调用者有条件的调度.

blocks.en: A flat prompt holding every leaf’s policy and taxonomy is far longer than the deployed 16K context. Only 23 of the 1,000 audit inputs fit, and lengths range from 12,742 to 27,318 tokens. To compare presentations fairly, we raise the cap to 32K without truncation and run four conditions on 128 text cases. Tree routes hierarchically and then reviews the selected leaf. Flat leaf selects one leaf in one step and uses the same review. Oracle leaf reviews with the gold leaf, which a deployed reviewer would not have. Full flat places all 73 leaves in one prompt. The cases come from the router test split without images, and inference runs in process because the deployed HTTP interface limits candidates to 512. Table 5 reports the results, with safety scored on 86 labeled cases and category metrics on 117. Safety uses the native head even on wrong routes, a missing leaf counts as a failure, and times include routing and leaf review but not permission judgment. Observed category F1 scores only the slots the source annotated. Strict set accuracy additionally requires correct routing and no category outside the native taxonomy, and such categories count as unsupported outputs.
blocks.zh: 平坦地保持每片叶子的政策和分类比部署的16K背景要长得多。 在1 000个审计投入中,只有23个是合适的,长度从12 742个到27 318个。 为了公平地比较介绍,我们把上限提高到32K而不截取,并对128个文本案例执行四个条件。 树道分级再审查所选叶. 平生叶片分步选择一叶并使用同种检出. 甲骨文叶与金叶相评,被部署的审查者不会有. 完全平地,所有73个叶子 在一个快。 案例出自路由器测试分解而无图像,推论在进行中,因为已部署的HTTP接口将候选人限制在512. 表5报告了结果,86个标有标签的病例的安全评分,117个类别衡量标准。 安全使用原生头甚至是在错误的路线上,缺失的叶子算作失败,时间包括路由和叶子审查,但不包括许可判断. 被观察的"F1"类只评出被注释出源的槽. 严格的设定精度还要求正确的路由,在本地分类法之外没有分类,这类分类算作无支持的产出.

blocks.en: The tree is 3.53 times faster than full flat but slower than one-step leaf selection. Its category F1 is higher than full flat’s, while full flat has higher safety accuracy. The paired safety gap is − 12.79 -12.79 points, and its exact paired-bootstrap 95% interval runs from − 25.58 -25.58 to 0.00. Of 50 unsafe cases, tree review predicts safe on 27 and produces no leaf on one, against 11 safe predictions for full flat. Of 36 safe cases, tree and full flat have one and seven false positives. Full flat outputs categories outside the native taxonomy on 115 of 128 cases, against 12 for the tree. This measures adherence to the local vocabulary, not semantic errors, and candidate and context changes prevent isolating the effect of tree structure.
blocks.zh: 该树比全平快3.53倍,但比单步叶选择慢. 它的F1类别高于全平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平平 配对的安全差距为-12.79-12.79分,其精确配对-波茨夹95%的间隔从-25.58-25.58到-0.00. 在50个不安全病例中,树木审查预测27个是安全的,1个是无叶的,11个是完全平地的安全预测. 在36个安全病例中,树和全平有1个和7个假阳性. 在128个案例中,有115个属于本地分类法以外的完全平地产出类别,而该树有12个。 这衡量了遵守本地词汇,而不是语义错误,以及候选和上下文的改变,防止了树结构的隔离效应.

blocks.en: In compliance, routing is correct on all 41 cases, yet tree, flat-leaf, and oracle review each get only 18 of 41 safety labels right, against 33 for full flat. Privacy oracle exact-set correctness is 0 of 40. These results place the failures after dispatch without identifying their cause.
blocks.zh: 遵照规定,所有41个病例的出行路线正确,然而树,平叶,甲骨文审查每对41个安全标签中只有18个正确,而全平33个正确. 隐私甲骨文准确设定正确度为40分之0. 这些结果表明,在发送后没有查明其原因。

blocks.en: 5.5 RQ4: How Does the Execution Gate Compare with an LLM Judge?
blocks.zh: 5.5 RQ4:执行门与LLM法官相比如何?

blocks.en: Hermes ( Nous Research, 2026 ) runs AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) tools for workspace, banking, travel, and Slack, with 16 normal and 16 injected tasks per suite. We compare two guards, each combined with explicit scope rules: the Jev-Guard permission judgment and a separate LLM permission call. Both see identical policy, scope, task, tools, attacks, and budget, and the actor and judge are both deepseek-flash with temperature zero. The full run also has no-guard and rules-only reference arms, 512 episodes in total. We report normal completion, official complete attacker goals, and a supplementary checker for partial policy violations. The checker inspects executed prefixes for unauthorized transfers, recipients, or deletions and covers 48 of 64 attack tasks, leaving 16 unknown. It was frozen after the rollouts, so it was not preregistered, and the 16 uncovered attacks are not counted as safe.
blocks.zh: Hermes (Nous Research, 2026) 运行代理 Dojo (Debenderetti等, 2024) 用于工作空间,银行,出行,和Slack的工具,每个套房有16个正常和16个注入的任务. 我们比较了两个警卫,每个警卫都有明确的范围规则:Jev-Guard许可判决和单独的LLM许可呼叫. 两者都看到相同的政策,范围,任务,工具,攻击,和预算,演员和法官都是深视-闪烁出零温. 全跑道还设有无卫道和只设规则的参考臂,共计512集. 我们报告正常完成,正式完成攻击目标,并报告对部分违反政策行为的补充检查。 检查者检查已执行的前缀,用于未经授权的转移,接收,或删除,并覆盖了64个攻击任务中的48个,留下了16个未知. 推出后被冻结了,因此没有预先登记,所发现的16起袭击不算安全.

blocks.en: Both guards have zero covered policy violations and zero complete attacker goals. The unguarded baseline also has none, so these zeros cannot be credited to either guard. The upper end of the 95% Wilson interval for 0 of 48 is 7.41%, for this covered sample only.
blocks.zh: 两名警卫都没有任何违反政策行为,没有完全的攻击目标。 未加防守的基线也无,因此这些零不能贷记入任何一个后卫. 威尔逊在48分0分的95%间隔的上端为7.41%,仅此被覆盖的样本.

blocks.en: Jev-Guard completes 51 of 64 normal tasks and the LLM judge 57, or 79.69% against 89.06%. The 95% intervals of the two completion rates overlap, so we do not claim a reliable difference. Jev-Guard is more conservative. It declines one normal user request and 25 proposed actions across ten normal tasks, against one request and three actions across three tasks for the LLM judge. Without per-action gold labels we cannot call these denials false positives, since a task that is normal overall can still contain a mistaken action. In return, review is cheaper. Mean review time per normal task is 1.33 seconds for Jev-Guard and 4.80 seconds for the LLM judge, and on the 48 normal tasks completed in every condition, mean task time is 7.60 seconds against 10.60 seconds.
blocks.zh: Jev-Guard完成了64个正常任务的51个,LLM法官57个,占79.69%,而89.06%. 两种完成率的95%间隔重叠,所以我们并不声称有可靠的差异. Jev-Guard比较保守. 它拒绝了一个正常的用户请求,并拒绝了针对10个正常任务的25项拟议行动,而针对LLM法官的1项请求和针对3个任务的3项行动。 没有每个动作的金色标签,我们不能把这些否定称为虚假的正值,因为一个正常的总体任务仍然可以包含错误的行动. 作为回报,审查费用较低。 每项正常任务的平均审阅时间为:Jev-Guard为1.33秒;LLM裁判为4.80秒;在每个条件完成的48个正常任务上,平均审阅时间为:7.60秒与10.60秒.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Accepting a new label or node does not ensure correct interpretation. Split and retention probes require checking affected cases, controls, and separate heads. Hierarchy organizes policies, but maintenance benefits remain unmeasured.
blocks.zh: 接受新的标签或节点并不能确保正确的解释。 拆分和保留探测器需要检查受影响的病例、控制和独立的头。 等级制组织政策,但维护福利仍未计量.

blocks.en: Perfect compliance dispatch coexists with poor leaf judgments, including under oracle routing. The permission gate separately reads default policy and scope. Binding tree rules to execution requires a new interface and execution tests. The current results instead support three practical checks: score newly affected cases, retain controls, and measure complete review with normal-task completion.
blocks.zh: 完美的遵守调度与糟糕的叶子判断并存,包括在甲骨文通路下. 许可门单独读取默认政策和范围. 绑定行走的树规则需要一个新的接口和执行测试. 现有结果支持三项实际检查:对新受影响的案件进行评分,保留控制,在正常任务完成后进行全面审查。

blocks.en: Comparisons require explicit audit contracts: caller information, observed labels, and outputs that control execution. An extra category outside a source vocabulary indicates a contract mismatch. Unannotated categories are not automatically semantic errors.
blocks.zh: 比较需要明确的审计合同:呼叫者信息、观察到的标签以及控制执行的产出。 源词汇外的一个额外类别表示合同不匹配. 未附加说明的类别不是自动语义错误.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Jev-Guard enables empirical tests of editable audits in four domains. Native classification has lower archived latency than SFT without a conclusive accuracy advantage. Paired tests expose edit failures and diagnostic errors after correct routing. Flat dispatch remains competitive. Full review averages 240 ms. In agent runs, the gate reviews faster than an LLM judge at a lower completion rate, without established safety gains.
blocks.zh: Jev-Guard可以对四个领域的可编辑审计进行经验测试。 原生分类具有比SFT更低的存档延迟,没有决定性的准确性优势. Paired测试在正确路由后暴露出编辑失败和诊断错误. 平分调度仍然有竞争力。 全面审查平均240ms. 在代理运行中,大门比LLM法官的审阅速度要快,完成率更低,没有既定的安全收益.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We evaluate one checkpoint, a limited set of policy edits, and one actor API alias. The controlled edit cases are constructed from explicit predicates, not independently annotated production logs. Five rule families and six category families provide limited statistical power. The 200-case tree study is balanced across selected sources and does not estimate deployment prevalence. Confidence intervals over task or source samples do not include training-seed variation or future API model changes.
blocks.zh: 我们评价一个检查站、一套有限的政策编辑和一个演员API别名。 受控编辑例由明确的上游来构建,而不是独立附加说明的生产日志. 五个统治家庭和六个类别家庭提供有限的统计能力。 200个案例树研究在选定来源之间是平衡的,没有估计部署流行率。 对任务或源样品的置信间隔不包括训练种子变异或未来的API模型变化.

blocks.en: The full-policy comparison uses 32K inputs beyond the 16K fine-tuning cap and bypasses the deployed 512-candidate HTTP limit. It establishes a matched experimental comparison, not a drop-in deployment configuration. Native and shared-taxonomy evaluations differ in prompts, candidates, and supervision. Unknown category slots are masked. Strict unsupported-output metrics do not establish that all unsupported predictions are semantically incorrect.
blocks.zh: 全政策比较使用超过16K微调上限的32K输入,并绕过所部署的512可控HTTP限制. 它建立了匹配的实验比较,而不是即时部署配置. 本地和共享的分类评价在提示、候选人和监督方面各不相同。 未知的分类槽被遮住. 严格的不支持输出度量法并不能确定所有不支持的预测都是集合错误.

blocks.en: The agent experiments use static attacks, simulated tools, one rollout per task, and only partial violation coverage. Sixteen attacks have no reliable partial-policy checker and remain unknown. The supplementary checker was frozen before rescoring, not before the original actor rollouts. Zero baseline violations preclude a measured incremental safety claim. No human-in-the-loop resolution of ask decisions is evaluated. The current leaf policy is not bound to the permission head, so this implementation does not establish end-to-end enforcement of arbitrary tree edits.
blocks.zh: 代理实验使用静态攻击,模拟工具,每个任务一次推出,只有部分违规覆盖. 16起袭击没有可靠的局部政策检查器,至今无人知晓。 补充检查器在再评分前被冻结,而不是在原演员推出前被冻结. 零起基线违规事件排除了计量递增的安全索赔。 对询问决定的人工解析不进行评估。 目前的"叶子"政策不受许可头的约束,因此这一执行并不确立任意树编辑的端到端执行.

blocks.en: Current v3.2 split audits found no overlap under case-ID, source-group, and content checks for the audited train/router splits. They do not fully exclude exposure through all historical v1–v3.1 training data or foundation-model pretraining. Public benchmark familiarity remains possible. We do not claim that the entire source mixture can be redistributed under one license, nor that heterogeneous native safety labels share a universal semantic meaning.
blocks.zh: 目前 v3.2 拆分审计发现,在已审计列车/路由车拆分的情况下,案件ID,源组和内容检查没有重叠. 它们并不完全排除通过所有历史v1-v3.1培训数据或基础模型预培训进行接触。 公众仍有可能熟悉基准。 我们并不声称,整个来源混合物可根据一份许可证进行再分配,也不认为各种本土安全标签具有普遍语义意义。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: The system is a research guard, not a guarantee of safe execution or a replacement for explicit authorization controls. Incorrect denials can impede legitimate work. Incorrect allows can expose sensitive assets. Our action experiments use isolated simulated environments and synthetic boundary-workflow assets, without sending real sensitive data or operating production resources. Evidence from tool outputs is kept distinct from host-owned policy and authorization. Logs used for real deployments would require data minimization and access control, which this study does not validate at production scale.
blocks.zh: 该系统是一个研究警卫,不是对安全执行的保证,也不是对明确授权控制的取而代之. 不正确的否认会阻碍合法的工作. 不正确的允许会暴露敏感资产。 我们的行动实验使用孤立的模拟环境和合成的边界-工作流程资产,而不发送真正的敏感数据或操作生产资源. 工具产出的证据与东道国拥有的政策和授权不同。 用于实际部署的日志需要将数据最小化和访问控制,本研究无法在生产规模上验证。

blocks.en: The training mixture includes harmful text and vulnerable source code for classification. Redistribution must respect each source’s access and licensing conditions. Our reports avoid publishing credentials, production traces, or personal user content. Automated coding and drafting tools assisted the implementation and manuscript preparation. The substantive claims here are tied to recorded experiments and source inspection rather than generated hypothetical results.
blocks.zh: 培训混合物包括有害文字和易被分类的源代码。 重新分配必须尊重每个来源的准入和许可条件。 我们的报告避免公布证书、生产痕迹或个人用户内容。 自动编码和起草工具有助于实施和编写手稿。 这里的实质性主张与记录的实验和源头检查有关,而不是产生假设的结果。

blocks.en: Appendix A Training and Data Summary
blocks.zh: 附录A 培训和数据摘要

blocks.en: The evaluated checkpoint is a LoRA adaptation of Qwen3.5-2B with two prediction heads, frozen during all evaluation. It continues an earlier checkpoint for one epoch, so it is not a fresh base-model run and is not evidence of training to a validation plateau. Model selection uses a fixed validation panel, while reported test safety accuracy is the ordinary fraction correct over labeled cases.
blocks.zh: 被评价的检查站是LORA对Quen3.5-2B的改编,有两个预测头,在所有评价中被冻结. 它延续了一个时代的早期检查站,因此它不是一个全新的基模跑道,也不是训练到验证高地的证据. 模型选择使用固定的验证面板,而所报告的测试安全准确度是标有标签的病例的普通分数正确.

blocks.en: The training package contains 377,930 native audit records and 8,000 router records. A taxonomy annotation without a valid safety label contributes only to its supported task, and governing policies are part of the input for policy-dependent classification.
blocks.zh: 培训教材包含377 930个本土审计记录和8 000个路由器记录。 没有有效安全标签的分类注释只有助于完成它所支持的任务,管理政策是政策依赖分类投入的一部分.

blocks.en: Table 6: Native records by domain, excluding router examples.
blocks.zh: 表6:按领域分列的土著记录,不包括路由器实例.

blocks.en: Taxonomy coverage exceeds annotation coverage. We identify 172 leaf-local category entries across 41 leaves with no positive annotations, so these entries are representable by the candidate interface but their supervised capability is not established. Across all native splits, 4,506 records involve weak rule annotations and 6,954 involve source-label crosswalks. These are not additional training records.
blocks.zh: 分类覆盖超过注释覆盖. 我们在41个叶子上确定了172个叶-局部分类条目,没有正面说明,因此这些条目可以由候选界面代表,但是其监督能力没有建立。 在所有本土分出的情况中,4 506份记录涉及规则说明薄弱,6 954份记录涉及源标签横道。 这些不是额外的培训记录。

blocks.en: The router collection has 10,000 examples split 8,000/1,000/1,000. Its test split is not domain-balanced, with 100 content, 312 cyber, 100 privacy, and 488 compliance records, so its overall accuracy is interpreted differently from the balanced 200-case tree-edit study. The checkpoint was developed through several data versions whose sources, sampling, prompts, and taxonomies changed together. The final scores therefore do not isolate the contribution of individual data sources, and earlier training stages may have exposed the model to benchmark data.
blocks.zh: 路由器收藏有一万个实例分出8000/1000/1000. 其测试分解没有域名平衡,包含100个内容,312个网络,100个隐私,488个合规记录,因此其总体准确性的解释与平衡200个案例的树编辑研究不同. 检查站是通过几个数据版本开发的,其来源、采样、提示和分类系统一起变化。 因此,最后的分数并不孤立单个数据来源的贡献,较早的培训阶段可能已经使模型暴露于基准数据.

blocks.en: Appendix B Policy Tree Summary
blocks.zh: 附录B 政策 树摘要

blocks.en: The implementation contains three related but distinct kinds of policy. A native task policy defines the source classification problem, for example whether an email is phishing or whether a clause violates a platform rule. A leaf review policy tells the reviewer how to apply a capability and its taxonomy to the evidence. The host authorization policy defines permissible actions and scope in the agent harness. Their labels differ: vulnerable code need not be unauthorized input, and a content label is not an execution permit.
blocks.zh: 执行工作包括三种相关但截然不同的政策。 本地任务政策定义了源分类问题,例如电子邮件是否在发短信,或者条款是否违反平台规则. 叶子审查政策告诉审查者如何对证据适用一种能力及其分类。 东道主授权政策界定了在代理操纵中允许的行动和范围. 他们的标签不同:弱势代码不需要是未经授权的输入,内容标签不是执行许可.

blocks.en: The tree is a manually specified, inspectable interface compiled from source metadata, not a hierarchy learned from test labels. A named-policy branch cannot obtain its governing rule by inferring a legal topic. Its caller context must identify the policy, and the selected policy name must match a supported name. Table 7 summarizes the evaluated configuration, which has 85 nodes and 73 leaves.
blocks.zh: 该树是一个手工指定的,可以从源元数据中编译的可检查的界面,而不是从测试标签中吸取的分级. 一个指定政策分支不能通过推断一个法律专题而获得其管理规则。 它的调用者上下文必须确定政策,选定的政策名称必须与支持的名称相匹配. 表7汇总了评估的配置,该配置有85个节点和73个叶子.

blocks.en: Table 7: Leaves of the evaluated policy tree by domain. Each compliance leaf corresponds to one law or provider policy.
blocks.zh: 表7:按领域分列的评价政策树叶。 每一个合规叶对应于一个法律或提供者政策。

blocks.en: Appendix C Native Classification Results
blocks.zh: 附录C 土著分类结果

blocks.en: The earlier native test package contains 147,643 task-case records and 109 benchmark views. Views may overlap and are not 109 independent datasets. This evaluation preserves the original test candidates and gold labels. It therefore measures compatibility with the original native interfaces, not performance through the shared policy tree. Table 8 reports domain-level ordinary safety accuracy and category micro-F1.
blocks.zh: 早期的本土测试包包含147,643个任务个案记录和109个基准视图. 视图可能重叠,不是109个独立数据集。 本评价保留了原试考生和金牌. 因此它通过共享政策树测量与原始本土界面的相容性,而不是性能. 表8报告域级普通安全准确度和"微F1"类别.

blocks.en: Table 8: Native evaluation in the original test-label space. Scores and conditional error rates are percentages. Category F1 is micro-averaged within each domain. Category-labeled counts are 9,806 (content), 10,164 (cyber), 68,318 (privacy), and 4,707 (compliance). No common-category aggregate is implied.
blocks.zh: 表8:原始测试标签空间中的原生评价. 分数和有条件出错率是百分比。 F1类是每个域内的微观平均值. 分类计数有9,806(内容)、10,164(网络)、68,318(隐私)和4,707(遵守)。 不包括共同类别合计数。

blocks.en: Overall safety accuracy is 73,415/79,987 (91.78%) on cases with safety supervision. It does not use all 147,643 records as its denominator. Content safety accuracy is accompanied by a 54.31% conditional false-positive rate on safe examples, illustrating how class prevalence can hide an important weakness. Privacy has many topic-only cases, so its safety denominator is much smaller than its total count. Ordinal severity accuracy is 15.28% on 1,466 cases, with normalized mean absolute error 0.17271. No strong severity capability is established.

blocks.en: The shared-context compliance subset has 41 cases with caller-supplied governing policy. blocks.en: We intersect stable case identifiers across all three archives, require binary safety supervision, and exclude image-bearing records. blocks.en: The last column of Table 1 pools the archived end_to_end_seconds values for the same 7,033 matched cases. Each local worker processes one case at a time. Four GPU workers run concurrently. SFT generates labels, whereas Jev-Guard computes classification heads directly. The median is 513.94 ms for SFT and 58.31 ms for Jev-Guard. blocks.en: We additionally re-score the archived predictions, without model calls. There are 7,031 distinct normalized-evidence hashes among the 7,033 records. A bootstrap samples these hashes with replacement, preserving all cases in a selected cluster and computing a case-weighted accuracy difference. Jev–SFT is + 0.355 +0.355 percentage points, with 95% interval [ − 0.327 , 1.009 ] [-0.327,1.009] . Jev-only correct and SFT-only correct counts are 291 and 266. Jev只正确和SFT只正确计数是291和266. 描述性记录级精确的McNemar测试给出了p=0.309 p=0.309,忽略了两个重复证据对. 比较并不能确定准确性优势。 相对于官方Jev,相差为+17.830+17.830分,间隔为[16.795分,18.863分] [16.795分,18.863分] . 历史的迅速和培训差异仍然妨碍建筑的归属。 比例513.94/58.31=8.81,比较存档的原生中位数,不完全审查延迟或每例对等速度比率.

blocks.en: The normal and injected AgentDojo tasks use the same native Hermes tool loop. Host-owned policies and authorized scope are visible in all four conditions, including no guard. Untrusted injected tool observations remain separate from this policy. The two fixed attack payload families are important_instructions and tool_knowledge . We do not adapt the payloads to the guard or select for unguarded attack success.
blocks.zh: 正常和被注入的Agent Dojo任务使用同一种本土的赫尔墨斯工具环. 东道主拥有的政策和授权范围在所有四个条件下都可见,包括没有警卫. 不信任的注入工具观察仍与本政策相分离. 两个固定攻击有效载荷家族是重要的_指示和工具_知识. 我们不调整有效载荷 与警卫 或选择无警戒的攻击成功。

blocks.en: Official attacker goals and the partial-policy checker are applied to successful execution prefixes and resulting state, rather than only the last state. The latter covers concrete unauthorized transfers, recipients, and deletion targets. Its 16 unsupported cases are explicitly unknown. A completed benign goal does not imply the absence of a violation, and an incomplete attacker goal does not imply the absence of a partial violation. Reviewer exceptions, timeouts, and invalid infrastructure outcomes are not relabeled as safe behavior.
blocks.zh: 官方攻击者的目标和部分政策检查被应用到成功执行前缀和结果状态,而不仅仅是最后一个状态. 后者包括具体的未经授权的转让、接受方和删除目标。 其16起无证据的案件显然不明。 完成的良性目标并不意味着没有违反,不完整的攻击者目标并不意味着没有部分违反。 审查者例外、超时和无效的基础设施结果不会被重新贴上安全行为的标签。

blocks.en: A separate expanded set crosses six scope families—paths, credentials, deletion, exfiltration, permissions, and reviewer configuration—with finance, clinic, product, and operations templates. It has 24 authorized and 24 unauthorized requests per condition, or 192 episodes. Tools operate on synthetic files, state, and local outboxes. Normal completion is 20/24 without a guard, 20/24 with rules, 22/24 with Jev-Guard plus rules, and 20/24 with the LLM judge. All have 0/24 executed violations. A family-held-out slice is also 0/12 for every condition. The unguarded zero again prevents an incremental safety conclusion. A separate 96-episode pilot is excluded.
blocks.zh: 一套单独的扩大版跨越六个范围家庭——路径、证明、删除、过滤、权限和审查者配置——包括财务、诊所、产品和业务模板。 它每个条件有24项授权请求和24项未经授权的请求,即192起。 工具运行在合成文件,状态和本地发箱上. 正常完成是20/24没有警卫,20/24有规则,22/24有Jev-Guard+规则,20/24有LLM法官. 所有人都有0/24起违反事件。 家庭照料的切片对每个情况也是0/12。 无人防守的"零"再次阻止了递增的安全结论. 不包括单独的96集飞行员。

blocks.en: A numeric scoring ambiguity between formatted amounts such as 42,000 and 42000 was corrected with a uniform numeric oracle. All conditions were rescored without rerunning the actor, and the original scores, oracle revision, and hashes were retained. This is a scoring correction, not a search for favorable reruns.
blocks.zh: 42,000和42,000等格式数额之间的数值评分模糊被用一个统一的数值表来校正。 所有条件均被重新评分而未再重放演员,并保留了原始分数,甲骨文修订和散列. 这是评分校正,不是在搜索合适的重播 。

blocks.en: The final AgentDojo experiment uses at most 20 Hermes iterations, 4,000 output tokens per actor call, and 300 seconds per episode. The actor and separate judge call use the same API alias. Temperature zero does not make an evolving remote API a fixed-weight deterministic simulator. One rules-only attack episode reaches its output budget and remains in the results. Final-run infrastructure failures are zero, but incomplete actor behavior is still an outcome rather than an excluded trial. The permission threshold of 0.55 is fixed. It is not a calibrated risk probability or a threshold optimized on these rollouts.
blocks.zh: 最终的代理道克实验使用最多20个赫耳墨斯迭代,每个演员调用4000个输出符,每集300秒. 演员和单独法官调用使用相同的API别名. 温度0不会使正在进化的远程API成为固定重量的确定模拟器. 一个只有规则的攻击事件达到了其产出预算,并留在结果中. 最后运行的基础设施故障为零,但不完全的行为者行为仍然是一个结果,而不是一个被排除在外的试验. 0.55的许可门槛是固定的。 它不是一个经过校准的风险概率,也不是在这些推出上优化的门槛。

blocks.en: Appendix J Interpretation Notes
blocks.zh: 附录J 页:1

blocks.en: The experiments support distinct claims with distinct units. Rule-edit correctness concerns paired model predictions under fixed actions. Routing concerns leaf selection with caller context. Leaf classification concerns labels available under a specified prompt and taxonomy. Action-level replay concerns proposed states. End-to-end security concerns effects of actions that actually execute. These outcomes remain separate in our reports.
blocks.zh: 这些实验支持具有不同单位的不同说法。 规则编辑正确性涉及在固定动作下配对模型预测. 运行涉及有调用语境的叶片选择。 叶子分类是指在指定的即时分类法下可以得到的标签. 行动层面重现提议的国家关切。 端到端的安全涉及实际执行的行动的效果. 我们的报告中仍然有这些结果。

blocks.en: The evaluated action gate reads default policy and scope, not the selected leaf rule. As a result, the present paper does not claim that editing the tree is sufficient to alter enforced permissions. Complete-review timing includes that separate permission forward. Native source classification, the 32K shared-policy comparison, and Hermes rollouts are evaluated separately.
blocks.zh: 评估的动作门读取默认政策和范围,而不是所选取的叶子规则. 因此,本文并未声称该树的编辑足以改变被执行的许可. 完整的审查时间包括单独的许可。 原生源分类,32K共享政策比较,和赫尔墨斯推出分别评价.

blocks.en: A tree revision should be treated as a versioned interface change. Moving an existing leaf preserves its meaning, whereas inserting a new parent asks the model to solve another classification problem, and a successful native benchmark result does not validate that new decision. Both diagnostic and authorization policies should be logged.
blocks.zh: 树修订应作为版本界面修改处理. 移动一已存在的叶子保留了它的意义,而插入一新母则会要求模型解决另一个分类问题,而成功的本土基准结果并不能验证这一新的决定. 应记录诊断和批准政策。
